description: AGSC-06-10 with AGSC-06-35: in the discovery document a related-system link's `type` and `title` are JSON strings (RFC 9264 §4.2.4.1) and its `profile`, an extension target attribute, is an array of strings even with one value (RFC 9264 §4.2.4.3). The case is the document the writer emits, not an intermediate list: `input.config` is the node's configuration, and `expected.related` is the value of the `related` member of the link context, links ordered by `href` (AGSC-06-10).
